description: Fire flickers and smoke drifts upward; the group and huts remain in place apart from a slight uniform drift of the frame; no clear character movement in 8 frames.
Eagle with the headband villager hanging below it moves up and left across the lake; head/body angle changes each frame; basket separates from him at f6209-6210.
Wooden basket drops from the figure and falls into the water, tilting as it goes.
Only a small basket floating on the water; background drifts slightly sideways (about 10-20 px at tile scale); no character motion.
Board, poster and teacher grow relative to the frame and move left across tiles; pan versus zoom not separable.
Stick pointer rises from horizontal to an angle toward the board as the teacher's arm lifts.
Background blurs and darkens at the edges while the figure stays crisp, onset f6428-6431.
White outlined caption 'step 1 : look up' scales up from tiny at f6432 to near full by f6434.
Figure tips from upright to horizontal and slides left-down across the grass in about 8 frames (f6662-6668); body rotates.
Eagle appears at top-left at f6663, flies down then right and up with wings raised, moving away.
Backpack slides left out of frame between f6767 and f6770.
Headband villager slides in from the right edge at f6770 and decelerates to rest left of centre by f6774.
Frame pushes in: teacher head grows and board text moves left and out; poster shifts right.
Teacher mouth cycles open/closed (speaking).
Figure holding upside-down eagle: small bob/swing of eagle and slight head shifts; background hill line shifts vertically a few px.
Tile content matches f7143-7150 pose-for-pose 31 frames later, suggesting a repeating animation loop (INFERRED from two strips).
Projected image shrinks to a thin horizontal strip and vanishes (this is the outgoing image: INFERRED since earlier frame f7246 shows a different image).
New painting (villagers at cooking pit) expands vertically from a band to full height; holds f7323-7326.
Previous painting collapses to a thin strip then a line.
New painting (eagle on rock over carcass) expands vertically to full height, holds f7389-7392.
Entire timeline graphic slides left with ease-out; numerals move about 58 px of 480 at tile scale across 8 frames; bear silhouette fully enters by f7451.
Smooth push-in on the board and teacher; text static, poster and desks leave the frame at left/right.
Terror-bird walks in from the right edge toward left with leg stepping; head moves about 0.69 to 0.53 of tile width.
'62 million' drops in from the top and settles at left-centre.
Dark vignette grows around edges; map shifts slightly left.
